based_on: youtube_spot_check.ipynb (version 1); transcripts read from its results, nothing transcribed again

normalisers.clean_urdu v1 + numbers as words: numbers_as_words() before clean_urdu v1, on gold and all systems

number_rules.integers: Urdu words 0 to 99; سو, ہزار, لاکھ, کروڑ, ارب; 100 = ایک سو
number_rules.group_separators: comma or Urdu comma between groups of 3 digits are removed
number_rules.decimals: اعشاریہ, then the digits after the point one by one
number_rules.percent: % or ٪ after a number becomes فیصد
number_rules.digit_by_digit: numbers starting with 0, or longer than 12 digits
